STRICT PRODUCT PRESERVATION: The product (matte black AirPods Pro 3 case) in the reference image must be reproduced EXACTLY as shown — same proportions, same shape, same orientation, same details. The FlickLock slider mechanism on the front of the case (mint-green button position, shape, and exact placement) and the small green status LED must remain IDENTICAL to the reference — do not redesign, re-position, restyle, or reinterpret the slider, LED, or any product element. Every physical detail of the product is locked.

ONLY change the following: replace the background and the lighting environment. Place the product against a pitch-black studio backdrop with a subtle radial vignette toward the edges. Cinematic key light from the upper-right creates a soft rim light along the case silhouette and a single specular highlight on the edge of the case. The case hovers slightly above the surface with a soft circular shadow beneath for dimensional grounding. Camera at the same low three-quarter angle as the reference.

Composition: case centered. No props, no hands, no text, no overlays, no other objects. Premium Apple-keynote aesthetic. Museum-grade product photography. Output 1:1 square.
